title: Dimension of Convex Partition Spaces in Three Dimensions
original_source: 2011 OWR Problem 2, printed p.2539: maximal realization-space dimension for n>3 convex regions of R^3
source_correction: OWR prints 4n-1 for regular diagrams; inspected Leon-Ziegler 2015 Theorem 6.2 proves 4n-5 and Conjecture 6.3 proposes that full dimension. The corrected conjecture is not represented as literal OWR wording.
retained_subclasses: pointed central fans: exact 4n-8 at fixed origin, 4n-5 with moving apex
cylindrical family: dimension 4n-5 with explicit nonregular members
remaining_gap: No proof that every affine partition realization stratum has dimension at most 4n-5; no counterexample exceeding that number.
